name: mobly-synchronized-multi-sniffer-capture-groups
instr:
Mobly cannot coordinate named sniffers as one owned capture group with atomic startup and a stable terminal result. Build groups with a readiness barrier and identical durable records in direct and suite execution, without changing single-sniffer runs.

Reject empty or duplicate membership before preparation or artifact creation. Prepare in declared order and start only after every member is ready. On failure, raise `CaptureGroupStartError` with a complete `report`, then abort prepared members in reverse order without touching later members. Make `stop` and `wait` idempotent, preserving member order and returning the same immutable `CaptureGroupReport` without repeated effects.

The `Sniffer` contract uses `CapturePreparation.ready`, `CapturePreparation.commit`, `CapturePreparation.abort`, `prepare_group_capture`, and `group_capture_capabilities`; reject unsupported capabilities before launch. Local subprocesses report ready only while live, remove temporary resources after readiness failure, and finalize exactly one artifact after success. Preserve tcpdump packet-count and additional-argument behavior while rejecting required native duration. Tshark supports duration and packet count through both existing executable lookup locations.
